## Foods & dishes
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈2,520 recipes (region "Irish" 2,532); amounts, steps, nutrition, not released.
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 658 recipes tagged `irish` (steps, nutrition, no amounts).
- [[CulinaryDB]]: "British Isles" 1,075 recipes shared with the [[United Kingdom]].
- Dish inventories: [[WorldCuisines]] 23 dishes (11 Ireland-only; barmbrack, blaa); [[FmLAMA]] 6 dishes (85 rows; Irish stew, boxty, champ, colcannon). Ingredient lists only.
- [[BLEnD]] `Irish_Ireland` (SemEval-2026, Irish language): 105 food questions, 314 answer clusters.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table for this country is in the vault or `Backlog/`; use [[USDA FoodData Central]] (and [[FooDB]] / [[Phenol-Explorer]] for compounds) by name matching.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 101 plants; [[NPASS]] 9 species–compound pairs.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Exposome-Explorer]]: 20 rows, incl. NANS (National Adult Nutrition Survey) concentrations and metabolomic associations.
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] ETHNOBOT 1 record; [[KNApSAcK Family]] World lists the country (edible/medicinal species records; counts for European countries were not scraped).
- Global backbone via [[Global]]: [[FooDB]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[CTD]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions.

## Gaps
- No Irish FCT and little human-cohort data.
- Irish dishes overlap with UK labels ("British Isles") in CulinaryDB.
